§2.1 Dixon–Coles recap:** joint pmf P(X_1=x_1,X_2=x_2) = τ_{λ_1,λ_2}(x_1,x_2)·Poisson(λ_1)·Poisson(λ_2), with τ shifting probability only among (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1) via dependence parameter ω̃ bounded by max(−1/λ_1,−1/λ_2) ≤ ω̃ ≤ min(1/(λ_1λ_2),1).

§2.2 Sarmanov family:** P(X_1=x_1,X_2=x_2) = P_1(x_1)P_2(x_2)[1 + ω q_1(x_1)q_2(x_2)] (Eq. 2), with bounded non-constant q_i satisfying Σ q_i(x_i)P_i(x_i) = 0 (Eq. 1); correlation ρ = ωu_1u_2/(σ_1σ_2), u_i = E[X_i q_i(X_i)].
§2.3 Key theoretical result:** Dixon–Coles is a Sarmanov member: with Poisson marginals, ω = −ω̃ and q_dc(x_i) = −λ_i if x_i=0, 1 if x_i=1, 0 if x_i≥2.
q̂_{(s)} with exponent s: −λ_i^s at x_i=0, λ_i^{s−1} at x_i=1.

Elo = SG-ML:** negative log-likelihood J_n(θ) (eqs. 10–14, convex) minimized by stochastic gradient, one step per game: θ̂_{n+1,i} = θ̂_{n,i} + K[s_i − Φ(Δ_i)] (eqs. 22–25), s_i ∈ {1, 1/2, 0}, K absorbing 1/σ′. Absorbing μ → K gives the classical Elo update.

κ-Elo (Davidson 1970):** Φ_κ(v) = 10^{0.5v/σ}/(10^{0.5v/σ}+10^{−0.5v/σ}+κ) (eqs. 47–49), Φ_D(v) = κ√(Φ_H(v)Φ_A(v)); update θ̂_{n+1,i} = θ̂_{n,i} + K[s_i − F_κ(Δ_i)] (eq. 60) with F_κ(v) = (10^{v/2}+κ/2)/(10^{v/2}+10^{−v/2}+κ) (eq. 57). κ=0 recovers binary Elo; κ=2 ≈ classical Elo's implicit model up to scale (eq. 50).

Frequency calibration:** p̄_D ≈ κ/(2+κ) (eq. 63); invert to κ̄ ≈ 2p̄_D/(1−p̄_D) (eq. 64). EPL p̄_D ≈ 0.25 → κ̄ ≈ 0.7. Classical κ=2 implicitly assumes p̄_D ≈ 0.5 — false in every competition where Elo is used.

Win-fraction cumulative distribution, infinite-game limit (Eq. 1): F(x) = 0 for 0 < x < q; F(x) = (x − q)/(1 − 2q) for q < x < 1 − q; F(x) = 1 for 1 − q < x. Hence the density f(x) is uniform on [q, 1 − q], zero elsewhere.
Cumulative master equation (Eq. A2): dGk/dt = q(G_{k−1} − Gk) + (1/2 − q)(G²_{k−1} − G²_k), with G_0 = 0, G_∞ = 1, Gk(0) = 1 for k > 0. Summing gives mean wins ⟨k⟩ = t/2.
Continuum PDE (Eq. A3): ∂G/∂t + [q + (1 − 2q)G] ∂G/∂k = 0, from replacing differences with derivatives.
Scaling ansatz (Eq. A4): Gk(t) → F(k/t) in the long-time limit; with x = k/t the win fraction.
Scaled ODE (Eq. A5): [(x − q) − (1 − 2q)F(x)] dF/dx = 0, whose admissible solutions (constant, or linear F(x) = (x − q)/(1 − 2q)) with boundary/continuity conditions F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1 yield Eq. (1).
